bundle - bose - quietcomfort wireless no.description: Under the spotlight of cutting-edge audio technology, the Bose QuietComfort Wireless Noise Cancelling Earbuds in Black redefine your everyday listening experience. These earbuds combine iconic Bose sound with legendary noise cancellation to deliver a rich and immersive audio experience that truly hits all the right notes. Designed for those who seize the day, these earbuds offer up to 8.5 hours of battery life, ensuring your music keeps you energized throughout your activities. The included wireless charging case provides an additional 2.5 charges, making it easy to power up on the go.Engineered with advanced Bluetooth 5.3 technology, these earbuds ensure a strong, continuous connection within 30 feet of your device, allowing you to enjoy uninterrupted music and seamless switching between devices. Whether you're moving from your phone to your laptop, Bluetooth multipoint technology makes it hassle-free to stay connected without missing a beat.The Bose QuietComfort Earbuds are designed with your comfort in mind. A trio of eartip and stability band sizes ensures a snug, secure fit that stays put, even during intense workouts. With an IPX4 water resistance rating, these earbuds can withstand splashes, drips, and sweat, making them perfect for any environment.Take control of your listening experience with customizable tap controls that let you skip tracks, adjust volume, and pause or play your music with ease. The Bose QCE app further enhances your experience by allowing you to personalize your sound with a five-band adjustable EQ, switch between Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) settings, and manage connected devices. Choose between Quiet, Aware, or Off modes to tailor your audio environment to your preference.This bundle also includes a 10000mAh 38.5Wh Qi Wireless Portable Power Bank, ensuring you have the power you need wherever you go. Available in Black, White Smoke, or Chilled Lilac, the Bose QuietComfort Wireless Noise Cancelling Earbuds offer sound without compromise, making every moment epic with their powerful and proven audio performance.
